T0674.title: Data Diode
T0674.definition: A data diode enforces one-way data flow across a network boundary through hardware or a controlled gateway.
T0674.description: Data diodes are used at industrial-control, critical-infrastructure, and high-security boundaries so monitoring data can leave a protected network while reverse connections are physically or logically prevented. They provide stronger directionality than ordinary firewalls but constrain interactive protocols, remote maintenance, and acknowledgements, requiring proxies, buffering, or protocol conversion.
T0674.usageExample: The control network sent logs one way through a data diode to the security operations center, with no reverse path to devices.
